transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-05-21
Time: 14:00 PT
Duration: ~49 minutes
Attendees: Jordan (Redwood AE), Samira (Redwood SE), Leo (Redwood CSM), Maya (StratusBridge), Carlos (StratusBridge), Priya (StratusBridge)

[00:00:05] Jordan: Hey everyone, thanks for joining. Uh, real quick agenda  pipeline review, two or three prioritized deals, and then next steps for co-sell motions. Maya, Carlos  you good with that?
[00:00:18] Maya: Yeah, that's great. Thanks Jordan. We've got a couple items to align on pricing and who's owning intros.
[00:00:27] Carlos: Quick note, we added FinEdge to the list, it's moving faster than we thought, so want to talk discounting.
[00:00:35] Samira: Cool; I'll flag the technical items up front  BigCorp needs VPC peering and strict data residency, RetailOne is mostly hosted but wants audit logs.
[00:00:44] Priya: Also, for partner rep handoffs  we want a clean intro template so our AMs don't drop the ball.

Summary/Context:
[00:01:02] Jordan: Context  we've been co-selling with StratusBridge since Q4, pipeline shows three mutual deals. I pulled the latest numbers but will update the sheet after today. Target is to close at least one net-new by Q3.

Transcript body:
[00:02:15] Maya: So BigCorp  it's the biggest one. They're concerned about PII and where logs are stored. They asked if Redwood can do a private deployment or at least VPC with KMS.
[00:02:30] Samira: Right, technically BigCorp needs either private control plane or strict VPC peering; we can do Redwood Private but the lead time is a thing. Alternative is Hosted with customer-owned KMS and audit logs, which reduces friction.
[00:02:52] Carlos: Lead time is the issue, they want something before fiscal year end, which is six weeks for them. Are we able to do a dev-level private instance sooner?
[00:03:05] Samira: Uh, we can provision a pilot in our Private offering but timeline's typically 6-8 weeks, depends on networking approvals. Might be tight. We could propose hosted with contractual commitments on data residency and bring-your-own-KMS as an interim.
[00:03:20] Priya: That seems reasonable. Also, do you have any SOC2 + ISO docs we can share with them? They requested evidence for security.
[00:03:32] Jordan: Yep, we'll share SOC2 report and security whitepaper  Samira, can you attach the security pack?
[00:03:38] Samira: Yes, I'll send it after. There's a link in our shared drive but I'll push the sanitized pack.

[00:04:50] Carlos: For FinEdge  quick note, their budget is smaller but timing is immediate. They asked about per-token cost and whether Redwood offers partner discounts.
[00:05:05] Jordan: We have partner discount tiers; typically we discuss a co-sell margin and commit to usage floors. For a smaller deal we can do a limited promotional discount; I can share the pricing sheet.
[00:05:18] Maya: For co-sell economics, StratusBridge expects 10-15% margin for partner-led introductions. Is that flexible?
[00:05:26] Jordan: We can be flexible depending on ACV and case study potential. For first-time co-sells we often accept a slightly higher rev-share to get traction.

[00:06:40] Samira: Technical question on FinEdge  they're using an on-prem model for embeddings and are concerned about latency if we route to hosted. Do we have benchmarks for their region?
[00:06:55] Samira: Sorry  do we have region-specific latency profiles (APAC vs NA)?
[00:07:02] Jordan: We have perf profiles in the console; I'll ask Samira to pull a few numbers and run a short benchmark.
[00:07:08] Maya: That would help the ask  they want to see 95th percentile latency under 200ms.

[00:08:20] Priya: RetailOne timeline is longer but they require audit logs and MFA. That looks straightforward?
[00:08:28] Samira: Yes, audit logs and SSO/SAML are standard. The bigger thing is integration with their internal ticketing system for usage alerts. We can support webhooks and CloudWatch  we should map the events they care about.

[00:09:50] Jordan: On the process  who will be the primary partner rep on StratusBridge side for intros?
[00:09:58] Maya: That would be me for BigCorp and Priya will own FinEdge intros. Carlos will help with legal.
[00:10:07] Jordan: Great. We'll send an intro template to standardize the handoff. Leo will own that.

[00:11:30] Leo: I'll draft one and include success criteria fields (SOW, pilot metrics, contacts). We'll also add a checklist for security docs.
[00:11:42] Priya: Perfect.

[00:12:55] (discussion  slight crosstalk, a few interruptions)
[00:14:10] Samira: Quick note on fallback  for BigCorp if Private is too slow, we can propose a hybrid: hosted with strict network controls plus contractual data residency clauses, and stage a migration to Private for production.
[00:14:26] Carlos: That keeps things moving. We need an estimate on cost delta for hybrid vs full private though.
[00:14:35] Jordan: I'll include cost delta in the updated spreadsheet.

[00:16:05] Maya: Any blockers from Redwood's side to run a short benchmark for BigCorp or FinEdge?
[00:16:13] Samira: We need partner to facilitate test accounts and possibly a sample dataset for realistic workloads. If StratusBridge can broker a sanitized sample vs BigCorp, that's best.
[00:16:25] Maya: We can arrange a sanitized sample.

[00:18:40] Carlos: Legal  BigCorp asked about standard indemnity and data processing addendum. We have a legal contact to loop in.
[00:18:50] Jordan: Send us the legal contact and we'll loop in Redwood legal. We'll also provide our DPA template.

[00:20:00] (short pause)
[00:20:18] Priya: Question  do you have any reference customers in financial services who did a hybrid rollout? BigCorp wants references.
[00:20:27] Samira: We do; I can share two anonymized case studies and a contact for a reference call.

[00:22:05] Jordan: Recap  items to deliver: updated pipeline sheet, security pack, co-sell playbook/email template, benchmark schedule. Owners are assigned.
[00:22:20] Maya: Sounds good. We'll prioritize BigCorp and FinEdge  hope to lock timelines by next week.

Closing and next steps:
[00:23:10] Jordan: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up with the sheet and next meeting invite for the technical deep-dive.
[00:23:22] Carlos: Thanks, talk soon.
[00:23:25] (meeting ends)
